title_card.title: Vikings never wore horned helmets.
title_card.subtitle: The horns were added by Victorian artists.

caption:
Vikings never actually wore horned helmets.

Excavated helmets from the Viking Age, dating between the years 793 and 1066, are simple dome shapes made of iron and leather. The famous horned myth was popularized by 19th-century costume designers for Wagnerian operas.
